scope: Complete deep-PM handoff requirements and standard regulator provider prerequisite; not system suspend acceptance

findings.finding: cpr_pm_prepare rejects non-s2idle suspend on MSM8926 because the MX supplier has active-only RPM requests. The MSM8926 domain stays ALWAYS_ON with permanently live APC and MX votes. Removing this guard without a full handoff does not implement sleep.

The current CPR consumer uses PM8226 L3, also used by SDHCI. Its active vote is calibrated and ordered against APC. Vendor CPR uses the active-only L3 peer; a separate sleep-only peer has a 750000 uV initialization. That vendor number is primary source policy, not proof that the current permanently live APC configuration can safely lower MX to it.

The current upstream SMD RPM regulator has no suspend voltage/enable/disable callbacks and sends only ACTIVE_STATE. Standard regulator callbacks can add explicit SLEEP_STATE requests without changing active caches, regulator bindings or DT policy. Regulator core invokes them during normal device suspend and propagates failures before later/noirq phases.

Standard core calls enable/disable before voltage. A successful sleep-enable request can therefore precede a failed voltage request. The provider primitive alone is not an atomic CPU/MX handoff or rollback proof, and must not be used to claim it is safe to enter sleep after an error.

Vendor lpm_system_prepare programs L2 mode, flushes queued RPM sleep requests and masks SMD receive interrupts, then programs MPM. Mainline MPM has a mailbox notification in its genpd power_off, but the current MSM8226 DT does not wire a CPU MPM/idle-state suspend topology and the current Qualcomm machine code provides no platform_suspend_ops. These are separate dependencies from the regulator provider.

The current MSM8226 L2 SPM owner arbitrates voltage and explicitly has no L2 low-power sequence. CPU SPC code retains L2 and restores STBY after cpu_suspend. An acknowledged regulator SleepSet does not add cluster collapse, retention/restoration or wake-source plumbing.

required_before_full_handoff: Standard sleep-set voltage/enable provider path with exact error propagation and preserved active state
Shared MX consumer requirements and an APC/MX sleep/wake voltage invariant, including failed preparation rollback
CPR feedback/IRQ quiescence and reestablishment of known APC/MX state on resume and abort
Actual CPU/L2 SPM low-power sequences, SCM/warm boot and platform suspend entry/exit ordering
MPM wake topology, pending wake/abort and RPM message/IRQ ownership across entry/exit
Maintained-LTS source and clean package reproducibility plus bounded physical suspend/wake/standby qualification
